147-4454-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4454-6798.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-4247-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1170-3698-5131-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3334-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3532-4985-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4985-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4509-6791.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-6791.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6705-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2397-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve both Exhibition Magician triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

803-5147-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-5147-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

232-2816-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1818-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1818-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2624-3179-4050-6992.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of creatures equal to or greater than 6 plus Leonardo's commander tax, if applicable.
2624-3179-4050-6992.description:
Cast Leonardo either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} due to its cost reduction.
God-Eternal Oketra and Oketra's Monument trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonardo, adding {W}.
Put Leonardo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2557-4050-4533-4807.notablePrerequisites: You control less than three Blood tokens.
2557-4050-4533-4807.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, adding {B}.
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster triggers, creating two Blood artifact tokens.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the Blood tokens, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2060-2511-2946-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2511-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2511-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

2178-2511-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-2511-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

198-3918-5090.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Trazyn.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
198-3918-5090.notes: In order to have a starting cost of {0}, Trazyn must have five or more charge counters to start the combo. If it has less, you will need to supply additional mana to supply the combo until Trazyn gets enough counters.

2557-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2557-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2557-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-779-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {1} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

276-791-3693-5934.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3693-5934.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-3875-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
1669-3875-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating a Treasure token for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens and/or Food tokens due to Tireless Provisioner's trigger.

4659-5003-5359.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding {C}{C}.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Threefold Thunderhulk from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Gnome, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

236-4019-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Nyx Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
236-4019-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Nyx Lotus to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

465-1430-3388.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Moritte  to the battlefield as a copy of Mirror Image, thus making it a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Moritte  enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Moritte .
When Moritte  leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2624-4050.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

148-1525-4179-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Keen Sense attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
148-1525-4179-4298.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving all creature you control +1/+1, trample, and infect untile end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.

4241-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4241-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4241-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
